parole.significato: halogen (any element of group 7 of the periodic table)
parole.testo: Borrowed from New Latin halogenium, from Swedish halogen, both coined by Jöns Jakob Berzelius, a Swedish chemist. Formed from Ancient Greek ἅλς (háls, “salt”) + -geen (“produce”), referring to elements which produce a salt in union with a metal.
Borrowed from New Latin vanadium or Swedish vanadium.

Borrowed from New Latin yttrium or Swedish yttrium. Named after Ytterby in Sweden. The first mention is from the late eighteenth century, which in fact referred to gadolinite, a mineral that was at the time misidentified as an element.
